title: Arkret Read Cursor Self-Management Operation DTOs
description: Closed request/response DTOs for the self-surface read cursor operations (ak.self.read_cursor.*). Advance carries the authenticated holder's exact signed ak.read_cursor.advance actor-private Event; the service validates and forwards it without rebuilding or co-signing. The durable cursor object model and read_scope / position field shapes are read-cursor.schema.json; that object has no updated_at, and the outcome updated_at here is the derived envelope created_at of the winning advance. See spec/v1/zh/discovery/read-receipts.md.

read_cursor_advance_request_body.description: Carries one caller-signed ak.read_cursor.advance Event and nothing else. The Event payload is the complete ak.schema.read_cursor.v1 object; actor_id is both envelope ownership and payload ownership, while payload device_id must equal the authenticated session device. The service MUST submit these exact bytes through authority Event submission and MUST NOT rebuild the payload or sign under a service identity. The cursor object carries neither an id (there is no read_cursor typed ID kind; identity is the (actor_id, realm_id, read_scope) tuple) nor an updated_at: a cursor is never updated in place, so the update time of an advance is the submitted Event envelope created_at and MUST NOT be restated in the payload.

updated_at.description: Derived, not caller-supplied: the envelope created_at of the ak.read_cursor.advance Event that currently wins the causal-first merge for this (actor_id, realm_id, read_scope). The cursor object itself carries no updated_at.
